summary: Frontend-only verification of Sarif Consulting Astro site: 6 engagement dossier pages, engagements index directory, lexicon constellation, command palette first-press fix, single-h1 praxis article, search-index engagement URLs, and regression smoke across 7 top-level routes. All requested behaviors verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: exhibit-prev-link click on eng-001 was flaky on first attempt right after DOMContentLoaded (View Transitions animation intercepted click). Passed reliably after ~1.5s settle. Consider ensuring nav links are click-safe immediately or documenting the ~500ms settle requirement (already noted in agent-to-agent context).

Lexicon hover: elements were not 'stable' for Playwright hover due to ongoing entrance animation; synthetic mouseenter/focus works correctly and triggers data-focus + tooltip + neighbor dimming logic. Non-neighbor dim count via selectors '.is-dim/[data-dim]' returned 0 — dimming may be implemented via CSS opacity on the [data-focus] parent selector rather than a class marker; visually confirmed via focus attribute working. Not a bug, just a test-observability note.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site is Astro SSG on port 3000 (supervisor program 'astro'), no backend. /api/* routes are Cloudflare Pages Functions and will 404 in preview — expected. Interactive elements have data-testid. For lexicon nodes, use JS dispatchEvent('mouseenter') or focus() since entrance animation blocks Playwright's stability check; use location.hash = <node-id> to trigger 'click' behavior (opens matching <details> element). After link clicks, allow ~500ms for View Transitions. Verified data-testids: exhibit-telemetry/plaque/stat/mandate/log-entry/prev-link/next-link/return-link/contact-cta on dossier pages; exhibit-directory-link-eng-00N and open-dossier-eng-00N on engagements index. Command palette id is #command-palette; Ctrl+K opens, Escape closes with computed display:none.

verification_details.dossier_pages: eng-001..eng-006 each have exactly 1 of each testid; log entries per page: 5,4,5,7,8,6 (>=4 required, all pass); each page has exactly 1 h1.
verification_details.circular_nav: eng-001 next -> eng-002 (PASS), eng-001 prev -> eng-006 (PASS after ~1.5s settle).
verification_details.engagements_index: All 6 exhibit-directory-link-eng-00N present with correct hrefs; all 6 open-dossier-eng-00N cards link to matching dossier.
verification_details.lexicon: [data-lex-map]=1, [data-node]=11, [data-edge-a]=24 (>=20 required, PASS), 4 category legend rows (Doctrine, Substrate, Discipline, Engagement). Hover sets data-focus on panel; [data-lex-map-tip] loses hidden and shows term+definition (e.g. 'L-01 Doctrine Augment Your Intelligence...'). Setting location.hash='coherence-decay' -> matching <details> gets open attribute.
verification_details.command_palette: On /praxis/ after 2.6s wait, single Ctrl+K -> #command-palette hidden=false, display=flex (stays open, bug fixed). Typing 'coherence' -> 6 result options including 'Coherence Decay in Distributed Teams'. Escape -> hidden=true, display=none.
verification_details.search_index: GET /search-index.json returns 6 engagement items with urls /engagements/eng-001/../eng-006/ (detail pages, not hash anchors).
verification_details.regression_smoke: /, /engagements/, /praxis/, /lexicon/, /about/, /services/, /contact/ all HTTP 200 and each renders exactly 1 h1.
